column1: # Each fuzz target's short budget (scripts/fuzz-short.sh): how many runs, and the seed they start
# from, from an empty corpus. A gate's fuzzing is then the same every time it runs.
# The runs: the median of what each target made in 3 s of wall time in 11 gates on the machine
# the gates share, each at a 5-minute load of 85 to 115 (the mean of the load before and after):
# i121b 85.8, i125a 100.5, i139b 102.1, i140c 87.0. At such a load a gate makes them in about the
# 3 s it gave them; at a higher one it takes longer, and makes no fewer. A run that cannot make
# them inside its cap fails, saying what each target made and the load.
